22	   searches of its generated catalog and relevant linked domain indexes.

24	   and existing wiki pages, including legacy flat pages; do not assume every
25	   page lives in entities/concepts/sources/synthesis.

27	   checks. Its generated findings are a starting point, not semantic verification.
28	   Check heading anchors, frontmatter aliases, index completeness and cross-domain
29	   coverage separately; the helper does not establish these or factual accuracy.
30	   Use `py system/scripts/wiki-maintenance.py --index` when index repair is
31	   authorized. Check both Markdown links and vault wikilinks, including path-qualified
32	   targets, aliases and anchors. Resolve targets against actual vault paths;
33	   avoid false broken-link reports from headings, code blocks, or external URLs.

35	   missing targets, duplicate subject pages, unindexed pages, and orphans.
36	   Distinguish navigation-only inbound links from useful knowledge connections.

38	   citations, confusing facts versus judgments, and stale operational snapshots.

40	5. Identify missing useful cross-references, significant subjects lacking pages,
41	   source coverage gaps, and unanswered questions. Suggest specific evidence to
